observed_failure.task_family: design direction followed by frontend implementation
observed_failure.durable_evidence: A bounded event reduction of the actual dogfooding run; no prompt, response, transcript, path, source, or private note content is retained.

pathology.why: The selected domain skill had a relevance decision but no explicit role boundary beneath current user, project, and approved personal design authority.

primary_metric: correct authority attribution in every conflicting design case without disabling the relevant domain skill
prediction: One bounded context-assembly rule will preserve the current user, project, and approved personal design decisions in all five cases while keeping frontend-design active as advisor or executor and adding no permission or broad personal-data read.
falsification_condition: Any case lets generic skill guidance override current user or project direction, lets personal guidance override a current explicit request, disables the skill, re-decides an implementation-only specification, reads unrelated personal material, expands permissions, or claims cross-domain generality.
guardrails: no raw personal content in durable evidence
no new service, schema engine, role system, or capability-specific hardcode
